label: qa-agent-round-2
message:
# QA agent brief: story ABC-123

You are the QA agent for story `ABC-123`. It is in `In Deployment Review`.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for story `ABC-123` from start to finish: read the story and enumerate what to verify, map each acceptance criterion and Definition of Done item to a lane, drive the surface and capture reproducible evidence, adjudicate and record, check the evidence into the repository, and make the closing status decision. Follow its evidence and status rules exactly.

Environment under test: the environment `ABC-123` was deployed to. The profile declares no environments (`profile.environments` is empty), so apply `qa-verification`'s own environment rule when no environment is named.

When you finish, hand back:

- the story's final state;
- the verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item;
- any item left outstanding and who owns it;
- any incidental defect you noted;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head (including an update-branch) needs a delta review posted before merging. Every merge must run the merge guard in `references/code-review.md` and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Work in your own scratch subdirectory: `{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/`.

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at `{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` using `- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per concrete step, with the current step marked `(in progress)`, and update it at every step.
